title: Tales of Symphonia Chronicles (USA) (En,Fr,De,Es,It)
outputName: Tales of Symphonia Chronicles (USA) (Ja voice, En text).chd
result: Tales of Symphonia: Japanese scene voices by default; set Customize > Voice Language to Japanese for the narration too. Dawn of the New World: set Options > Voice Language to Japanese. English text in both. The French, German, Spanish and Italian data is removed.

ops.why: Tales of Symphonia reads RAWDATA/X.AWB for English voices and RAWDATA/VOICE_JP/X.AWB for Japanese voices. Each pair has the same 376 waveform IDs (checked for SCE_001_009.AWB).
ARCHIVE/R01 holds the base data and English. R02 to R05 are the four other languages of the disc (En,Fr,De,Es,It). The small FILEHEADER.TOFHDB files stay, in case the game reads all headers at boot.

tested.device: AYN Thor, CHD on the SD card
tested.result: Passes, speech detection on audio dumps. Tales of Symphonia: default setting gives Japanese scene voices and an English narration; Voice Language = Japanese gives Japanese narration too. Dawn of the New World with Voice Language = Japanese: Japanese narration, English text, audio works.

rejected.why: Removed 2026-10-03: with it, Dawn of the New World plays no audio at all after the launcher starts it (the audio dump stops; the original and the image without this op play audio). Two of the swapped cue sheets differ in size between English and Japanese (WS_TOSM_AMB.ACB, WS_TOSM_BTL_VOICE.ACB); the game may read them with sizes from its own file table. Not proven which file. Use the game's Voice Language option instead.
